currentState: Stage 3 consumes approved existing certificates; it never creates or repairs mappings.

rules: Repeated physical pads are represented by distinct exact pad identifiers, never array order.
Multiple pads per symbol pin are one entry with every exact pad number.
Multiple symbol pins per pad require explicit entries and a verifier finding proving shared electrical intent.
Mechanical pads and mounting holes are listed separately and cannot acquire a signal net.
No-connect and do-not-connect pins use intentional-no-connect with explicit evidence.
Hidden pins remain explicit symbol identities; they cannot be inferred from power-net names.
Exposed pads use exposed-pad and require the exact thermal/electrical intent evidence.

authorizedActors: authorized validation service followed by policy approval
approval.writeRule: Write a new immutable mapping certificate and atomic revision; never mutate an existing certificate or PCB.

stage3Invalidation.behavior: Any mapping certificate ID, artifact digest, symbol/footprint dependency, verifier policy, or approval-state change invalidates the materialization and every unapplied plan.
stage3Invalidation.response: Stage 3 must reacquire the snapshot, rerun Stage 2 and re-preflight before apply.

legacyMigration: Legacy order/count/name-derived mappings remain unverified and blocked. Stage 4 may create a reviewed immutable certificate; it may not relabel legacy data as verified.
fixturesToPreserve: same footprint name with changed content digest
mapping certificate changed under unchanged footprint
authorityBoundaries: Stage 4 does not choose a footprint.
Stage 4 does not alter schematic or PCB connectivity authority.
Stage 4 does not mutate a board.
Stage 3 accepts only an exact current approved mapping and uses its pad assignments verbatim.
